label: Figure 11.14: The demand curve for a firm in monopolistic competition
alt: A fairly flat downward-sloping D = AR with a steeper MR below it and a U-shaped MC; MC cuts MR at output q and price P is read up to AR.
caption: Because there are many close substitutes, the firm’s D = AR curve is downward sloping but relatively elastic (fairly flat). MR lies below it and falls twice as steeply. The firm produces at q where MC = MR and charges P, read from the AR curve.
